describe: A level written as storeys (level format 2): its text in a module, with its rooms' markers and floors, a door, windows, a flight of stairs to the floor above, a railed stairwell and a gable roof, with a unit test that it compiles to its storeys and rooms, each room's marker inside it, and passes every check node x qa level runs: every spawn and room reached, doors wider than a body, headroom, flights walkable (PLAN.md WP 13.13).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/levels/<name> (its id is level:<name>; a scene names it, level: 'level:<name>'): labs/box/levels/cabin
next: draw its storeys as its file comment says, its room markers' characters no other glyph's; import {{id}}.ts from the scene that plays it (level: 'level:{{name}}', and in its setup addLevelBodies(physicsOf(w), getLevel('level:{{name}}')) for its bodies); see it with node x eye <scene> (no GPU) or node x shot <page> --scene <scene>; then node x docs --write
